figurative_meaning_en: without paper and pen (verbally or orally)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি মুখে মুখে গল্পটা বলো, লিখে দিতে হবে না।
পরীক্ষায় মুখে মুখে উত্তর দিতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Tell the story verbally, no need to write it down.
In the exam, you have to answer orally.
note: This idiom reflects the oral tradition prevalent in Bengali culture before widespread literacy.
